title: Farmers Train for Success in Agriculture

subtasks.task_text: Explain the goals of the five-week training programme.
subtasks.text: Detail the range of topics covered, including good agricultural practices, cultivation management, and business planning.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss the importance of knowledge sharing and networking among farmers.
subtasks.text: Note Secretary Barry Morphillisier's encouragement for farmers to share knowledge.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight the role of education and attitude in achieving success.
subtasks.text: Observe that education and attitude are critical for getting to good agricultural practices.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the significance of a training programme in a successful project.
subtasks.text: Note Ambassador Peter Cheyenne Chen's congratulations and his encouragement for farmers to take advantage of opportunities.

subtasks.task_text: Detail the outcomes of the training programme.
subtasks.text: Mention that over 250 farmers have been certified through the programme.
